info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Underwriting Id-spec
info.description: The Sale Retrieval API provides a streamlined approach for accessing sales data based on specific underwriting identifiers. It allows users to retrieve detailed information about sales linked to a particular underwriting ID, facilitating better tracking and management of sales records. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions, underwriting teams, and customer service representatives who need quick access to sales information. By enabling efficient querying of sales data, it supports businesses in making informed decisions and improving customer interactions.

get.summary: Retrieve Underwriting Details for a Specific Sales Resource
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed underwriting information related to the specific sales resource identified by the ID 'RES-100045'. The data returned includes all relevant underwriting metrics and status updates, facilitating deeper insights for sales analytics and decision-making processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve underwriting information for the specified sales operation identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the request payload follows the defined schema for correct processing.
